title: Exempt ee4b0dd from the history check per D66 option (a)
summary: Add the full 40-character id ee4b0dd1aa6fcd81289dc988d0f7bd38fd7a40ef to `[history] exempt` in athena.toml, as the user chose option (a) in D66. Record the choice in docs/decisions.md and CHANGELOG.md. No code or workflow changes.

defaults_applied.how: The full commit id came from the request and the cause from D66 in docs/decisions.md, so no question is needed.
One config entry plus its decision record.
The existing history check enforces the exemption; D60 requires the full id.
The comment and decision text explain why the commit is excused.
The change adds only a commit id and prose.

assumptions: The user chose (a) alone; (c), the merge-strategy habit, is not implemented here.
Only the exempt list changes; D66's code analysis stands and no code or tests change.
The new entry is appended after the two existing entries, with a comment saying why.

acceptance_criteria.text: athena.toml `[history] exempt` contains exactly the existing two ids plus ee4b0dd1aa6fcd81289dc988d0f7bd38fd7a40ef, as a full 40-character id.
The comment above the list explains that ee4b0dd is the multi-job squash of PR #8, excused by the user's choice of D66 (a).

docs/decisions.md records the user's choice of (a) for D66, by amending D66 or adding a new entry that states what was decided, the tradeoff, and the reversal (delete the entry). It states that (c) is not yet adopted.
`cargo test` passes and `cargo clippy` is clean, so the existing config-parsing and exemption tests still pass with the new entry.
No files other than athena.toml, docs/decisions.md and CHANGELOG.md change. athena.toml is the only governance file touched.

out_of_scope: Changing `landing` in invariant.rs to accept multi-job commits (option b)
Setting or enforcing the repository's merge method (option c)
departures: The change is small and mechanical, so cost and pass probability are better than the reference. The main risk is that the gate rejects an exemption for a multi-job squash or a doc edit.
